text:
emily: Quick quarterly check-in — please drop one-line status for your milestone (shipped/slipped/blocked), owner, and any cross-team deps. I’ll consolidate for the exec sync.

alex: Runtime v3 autoscale testing finished, shipped to staging, will target canary next week. owner: alex. dep: infra infra-queue capacity (sam) :thumbsup:

maria: Embeddings infra rollout slipped — missed a storage shim regression. owner: maria. blocked on storage fix from eng-infra (jin) — ETA EOD Wed.

sam: infra-queue capacity = provisioning in progress, ETA Tue AM. will post capacity numbers when available. owner: sam.

jin: Storage shim PR opened: <https://git.redwood/team/eng-infra/pull/842>. I need a review on the perf change, cc @maria. Not blocking other work but blocks embeddings rollout.

emily: @maria can you confirm if we should hold canary or proceed with degraded metrics?

maria: Hold canary for embeddings — we expect noisy failures if shim not in. will re-evaluate after jin's PR merges.

alex: For runtime v3 canary we can route 10% -> runtime-v3, fallback to runtime-v2 automatically. If storage issue impacts only embeddings we can still run generation canary.

sam: FYI, Dedicated capacity commit is on legal review. If legal clears this week we keep autoscale targets. owner: sam.

emily: Code review pings: alex pls ping infra for the canary routing rule change (small config). maria pls ping security for embeddings dataflow review. I'll add both to the weekly sync.

alex: Pinged infra in #eng-infra, link to config diff:```diff
--- routing.yaml
+++ routing.yaml
@@ -12,7 +12,8 @@
   - name: runtime-v3
     weight: 0.1
+    fallback: runtime-v2
```

maria: Security review request created: JIRA INF-1192. tagging @security on the ticket.

jin: Merged shim PR, running canary perf jobs now. logs: `ci/shim-canary-1795.log` — no regressions on p95 so far.

sam: Capacity numbers posted: 2x additional GPUs queued for provisioning, expected live Tue 09:00 PST.

emily: Great — next steps: (1) jin to confirm stable canary perf by Tue EOD, (2) maria to re-check embeddings after shim is live, (3) alex to open canary rollout ticket for runtime-v3 -> assign owners and fallback policy, (4) sam to confirm Dedicated commit legal clearance.

alex: Opening canary ticket now and assigning reviewers. ticket: <https://jira.redwood/browse/RUN-4021>. owner: alex.

maria: Will do a smoke eval harness once shim is in. ETA Wed morning for full pass.

deploy-bot: Deploy started: runtime-v3-canary -> 10% (deploy id: d-20260318-179580).

sam: Noted, will update capacity channel when GPUs show ready.

emily: Thanks all — I’ll synthesize this into the exec one-pager. If anything changes, drop a short update here (one-line).
